verdict.rationale: Kling's own marketing says users can "batch-produce videos, and automate the entire production process," and it offers an in-product Agent and parallel Skills. That is a thin, first-party claim of automated production. There is no documentation of how automations are set up, triggered, scheduled, or run unattended in the background; the MCP/CLI entry describes external agents driving Kling, which is a building block, not Kling's own automation feature. Missing for 10: documented automation setup, background or unattended execution, scheduling or recurring triggers, status monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Generate multiple versions at once to test styles, batch-produce videos, and automate the entire production process.
